e.z: 那自然也会损害到她对他的评价。

e.e: He insisted that he had done right.
e.z: 他坚决认为自己做对了。

e.e: They insist that I stay there for supper.
e.z: 他们坚决要求让我留下吃晚饭。

e.e: Since you insist, I must amend the letter of credit.
e.z: 既然你坚持，我就只好修改信用证。

d.m: 鼓舞；激发；产生；赋予...灵感

e.e: We're trying to inspire him with confidence.
e.z: 我们在努力鼓舞他的自信心。

e.e: The sight inspired him with nostalgia.
e.z: 这景象激起了他的怀旧之情。

e.e: The failure inspired him to greater efforts.
e.z: 失败激发他作更大的努力。

e.e: She installed her air-conditioner without help by herself.
e.z: 她自己安装了空调。

e.e: The workers are installing a heating system.
e.z: 工人们正在安装供暖系统。

e.e: It is necessary that you install a burglar alarm.
e.z: 你有必要装防盗警报器。

e.e: I haven't been to the exhibition, neither do I intend to go.
e.z: 我还没有看展览会,我也不想去。

e.e: My husband trusts me and I don't intend to break that trust
e.z: 我的丈夫信任我,所以我不想失去这种信任

e.e: I've chosen the main actors and we intend to put it on next January.
e.z: 我已经选好了主要演员,打算明年一月上演这出戏。

d.m: 包含；使忙于；牵涉；使卷入；使陷入

e.e: A letter of credit will involve unnecessary extra charges.
e.z: 信用证包含有不必要的额外开支。

e.e: The Genius is a lovable physicist who is deeply involved in defining the workings of the universe.
e.z: 老天才是一位可爱的学者，他整天忙于解释天地间的各种现象。.

e.e: Don't involve other people in your trouble.
e.z: 别把别人牵涉进你的麻烦中去。

e.e: We must isolate the handful of enemies to the maximum.
e.z: 我们要最大限度地孤立一小撮敌人。

e.e: We should never isolate ourselves from the masses.
e.z: 我们永远不能脱离群众。

e.e: The patient should isolate from his child.
e.z: 这个病人必须立刻和他的孩子隔离。

d.m: 替 ... 辩护；证明 ... 正当；调整版面

e.e: He had to justify himself for his conduct.
e.z: 他不得不为自己的行为辩白。

e.e: Don't try to justify your mistakes.
e.z: 不要为自己的缺点辩护。

e.e: Nothing can justify your cheating on an exam.
e.z: 任何事情都不能成为你考试作弊的理由。

e.e: Her decision seems to show a lack of political judgement.
e.z: 她的决定似乎显示出缺乏政治判断力。

e.e: Lack of sun retards plant growth.
e.z: 光照不足则植物生长缓慢。

e.e: In a cold winter, many wild animals can die from lack of food.
e.z: 在严寒的冬天,很多野生动物可能因缺乏食物而死去。

d.m: 发起；推出（新产品）；发射；使(船)下水

e.e: We were going to launch a counterattack.
e.z: 我们准备发起反攻。

e.e: The company researched the market demand and decided to launch their new product.
e.z: 这家公司调查了市场需求，决定推出新产品。

e.e: The people all over the country exulted in the success in launching a new satellite.
e.z: 全国人民为成功地发射了一颗新的人造卫星而欢欣鼓舞。

d.m: 维持；维修；保养；坚持；断言

e.e: It is absolutely vital that food supplies should be maintained.
e.z: 维持食物的供给是绝对必要的。

e.e: They also help us to maintain the machinery.
e.z: 他们还帮助我们维修机器。

e.e: They tell the peasants in detail how to maintain the pumps.
e.z: 他们详细地教给农民怎样保养抽水机。

d.m: 管理；经营；做成；设法对付；提供；有空

e.e: He managed the company when his father was away.
e.z: 他父亲离开的时候,由他管理公司。

e.e: The success of the restaurant lies in that it is well managed.
e.z: 这个餐厅的成功在于它的完善经营。

e.e: I shall be able to manage it without help.
e.z: 我一个人能行。

e.e: Governments consider it prudent to minimize the risk.
e.z: 各国政府均认为把这种危害降低到最小程度的做法是明智的。

e.e: The polar explorers took every precaution to minimize the dangers of their trip.
e.z: 极地探险者十分小心谨慎，以便使旅途的危险性减少到最小。

e.e: A sound approach to the problem is to minimize the number of parts.
e.z: 正确解决这一问题的方法是把零件的数目减至最少。

d.m: 激发(兴趣或欲望)；给与动机

e.e: He is just sitting there doing nothing. He needs to be motivated.
e.z: 他坐在那儿什么也不干,他需要一点动力去激发他。

e.e: The crime appears to have been motivated by hatred.
e.z: 犯罪似乎都来自于仇恨。

e.e: A good teacher is one who can motivate his students.
e.z: 好老师是能激励学生的老师。

d.m: 谈判达成；成功越过；议价出售

e.e: We've decided to negotiate with the employers about our wage claim.
e.z: 我们决定就工资问题与雇主谈判。

e.e: We are happy to negotiate with you in that way.
e.z: 我们很高兴用这种方式来和贵方协商交易。

e.e: Trade union leaders went back to negotiate with the government.
e.z: 工会领导回去和政府进行交涉。

e.e: We have to observe carefully what's going on there.
e.z: 我们必须仔细观察那里的动静。

e.e: He made a telescope through which he could observe the stars.
e.z: 他做了个望远镜,用其观察星座。

e.e: All citizens should observe traffic rules.
e.z: 每位公民都应该遵守交通规则。

e.e: He failed to obtain a scholarship.
e.z: 他没有获得奖学金。

e.e: At last, their company obtained the mining concession.
e.z: 他们的公司最终获得了采矿权。

e.e: Those who were penitent obtained absolution.
e.z: 悔过者获得了赦免。

d.m: 占用；占领；从事；使忙碌；专心

e.e: Is that seat occupied?
e.z: 那个座位有人吗？

e.e: Reading occupies most of my free time.
e.z: 阅读占去了我大部分的闲暇时间。

e.e: We occupy the farm and raise a lot of poultry.
e.z: 我们拥有这个农场并养着许多家禽。

d.m: 提供；提出；（卖方）出价；贡献

e.e: We offer a free backup service to customers.
e.z: 对顾客我们提供免费配套服务。

e.e: Can you offer any evidence in support of what you have said?
e.z: 你能提出证据来印证你讲的话吗？

e.e: We offered 100,000 for the warehouse, but another company outbid us.
e.z: 我们出价1000,000英镑购买这个库房,但另一家公司出价高于我们。

e.e: It's too difficult for him to operate this new sophisticated machine.
e.z: 对他来说,操作这台复杂的机器太难了。

e.e: The lift doesn't operate properly.
e.z: 这台电梯运转不正常。

e.e: They operate three factories and a huge warehouse.
e.z: 他们经营三家工厂和一个大仓库。

e.e: It was courageous of him to oppose his chief.
e.z: 他敢反对他的上司，真是勇敢。

e.e: The rabbles met on the square to oppose their new mayor.
e.z: 平民们在广场上集会反对他们的新市长。

e.e: They opposed the government's new policies.
e.z: 他们反对政府的新政策。

e.e: The meeting was badly organized.
e.z: 会议组织得很糟。

e.e: They planned to organize a scientific expedition.
e.z: 他们计划组织一次科学考察。

e.e: I was asked to organize the trip, but I messed it up.
e.z: 大家要我组织这次旅游，可是我把事情搞糟了。

d.m: 俯瞰；远眺；没注意到；忽视

e.e: My room overlooked the garden.
e.z: 我的房间俯瞰花园。

e.e: We overlook the church from our house.
e.z: 我们可从家中俯瞰教堂。

e.e: My room overlooks the sea.
e.z: 从我的房间可眺望大海。

e.e: Everyone in the class is expected to participate in the discussion.
e.z: 希望全班同学参加讨论。

e.e: In the ancient Greek Olympics, only men were allowed to participate in it.
e.z: 在古希腊奥运会中,只允许男人参加比赛。

e.e: I don't want to participate in the English party.
e.z: 我不想参加英语晚会。

d.m: 注意到；觉察到；认为；理解

e.e: I plainly perceive some objections remain.
e.z: 我清楚地察觉到还有一些反对意见。

e.e: We can perceive his sorrow by the looks on his face.
e.z: 我们从他的表情中觉察出悲伤。

e.e: Indeed, this problem is greater than one may perceive.
e.z: 确实，这个问题远大于你所能感知到的。

d.m: 执行；履行；表演；运转；举行

e.e: Every manager must perform some duties of a ceremonial nature.
e.z: 每个管理者必须执行一些礼仪性的任务。

e.e: Student teams perform a comprehensive analysis and valuation of a business, as outlined in the syllabus.
e.z: 如同课程大纲所提及，每一组学生都要对一个企业执行广泛的分析与评价。

e.e: They always perform their duties faithfully.
e.z: 他们总是忠实地履行自己的职责。

e.e: How can I persuade you of my sincerity?
e.z: 我如何能够让你相信我的诚意？

e.e: We are persuaded of the justice of her case.
e.z: 我们确信对她案件的审理是公正的。

e.e: I am not fully persuaded by the evidence.
e.z: 这证据不足以使我充分信服。

e.e: Different workers possess different skills.
e.z: 不同的工作者有不同的技能。

e.e: Rose is a woman who possesses a rare intelligence.
e.z: 罗丝是一个拥有非凡智慧的女人。

e.e: The police asked me if I possessed a gun.
e.z: 警察问我是否有枪。

e.e: It is virtually impossible to predict the future accurately.
e.z: 精确预言未来的事实际上是办不到的。

e.e: The economists predicted an increase in the rate of inflation.
e.z: 经济学家预言通货膨胀率将会增长。

e.e: The earthquake had been predicted several months before.
e.z: 这次地震早在几个月以前就发布了预报。

e.e: I would prefer to stay home rather than go out on such a rainy day.
e.z: 在这种雨天，我宁可待在家也不出门。

e.e: All this gracious living is not for me；I prefer the simple life.
e.z: 这种优裕的生活对我不合适；我还是更喜欢简朴的生活。

e.e: Which one do you prefer, an apple or an orange?
e.z: 你想要哪个，苹果还是橘子？

e.e: Early experiments with military rockets prepared the ground for space travel.
e.z: 早年对军用火箭进行的实验为发展航天技术奠定了基础。

e.e: He is preparing his speech for the meeting tomorrow.
e.z: 他正准备明天集会的演说。

e.e: Prepare to alight,for we are almost there.
e.z: 我们马上就要到了

e.e: It is highly important to preserve the environment.
e.z: 保护自然环境至关重要。

e.e: It's the duty of the police to preserve the public order.
e.z: 维护公共秩序是警察的职责。

e.e: You should preserve your papers for future use.
e.z: 你应当把你的文件保存起来以备将来之用。

e.e: She pretends that she likes them so that she can get their help.
e.z: 她假装很喜欢他们，借以获得他们的帮助。

e.e: The young actor pretended to be Hamlet.
e.z: 那个年轻演员扮演哈姆雷特。

e.e: She closed her eyes and pretended to be asleep.
e.z: 她闭上眼睛,装作睡着了。

e.e: Scientists are trying to find ways to prevent disease.
e.z: 科学家们正试图找到预防疾病的方法。

e.e: It is the job of the police to prevent crime.
e.z: 防止犯罪是警察的职责。

e.e: Nothing can prevent us from carrying out the plan.
e.z: 什么也无法阻挡我们去实施这个计划。

e.e: We received sanction to proceed with our plans.
e.z: 我们获准继续进行我们的计划。

e.e: Please go upstairs and proceed through the security check and immigration.
e.z: 请您到楼上继续进行安全检查和移民检查。

e.e: Please proceed with your presentation.
e.z: 请开始你的简报。

d.m: 生产；引起；提出；制片；分娩

e.e: This tree produces rubber.
e.z: 这些树生产橡胶。

e.e: It is certain that we shall produce this kind of engine.
e.z: 毫无疑问,我们将生产这种发动机。

e.e: The plain weave is comparatively inexpensive to produce.
e.z: 相对来说,平纹组织的生产成本较低。

d.m: 进步；发展；缓速前进；促进

e.e: The student is showing rapid progress in his studies.
e.z: 这个学生学习上进步很快。

e.e: Physics has made enormous progress in this century.
e.z: 本世纪物理学的发展突飞猛进。

e.e: They made slow progress towards the mountaintop.
e.z: 他们向山顶缓慢地前进。

d.m: 促进；提升；升迁；发起；促销，推销

e.e: They discussed how to promote cooperation between the two countries.
e.z: 他们讨论如何促进两国间的合作。

e.e: He has been promoted to general manager.
e.z: 他已被提升为总经理。

e.e: He failed to get promoted for lack of resolution.
e.z: 他因缺乏果断力而未能得到升迁。

d.m: 打算；计划；向 ... 提议；求婚；提名

e.e: I propose an early start tomorrow morning.
e.z: 我打算明天早上早点出发。

e.e: He proposed to buy and run a farm.
e.z: 他计划购买并经营一个农场。

e.e: The committee proposed that new legislation should be drafted.
e.z: 委员会建议着手起草新法规。

e.e: He raised his arm to protect his child from hurt.
e.z: 他伸出手去，保护他的孩子免受伤害。

e.e: These gallant soldiers will protect our country.
e.z: 这些勇敢的士兵会保卫我们的国家的。

e.e: These rare tigers are protected by special laws.
e.z: 这些珍贵的老虎受到专门法律的保护。

e.e: There wasn't enough evidence to prove him guilty.
e.z: 没有充分的证据证明他有罪。

e.e: He has proved his courage in the battle.
e.z: 他已在这场战斗中证明了自己的勇气。

e.e: The students are asked to prove the purity of copper.
e.z: 要求学生们检验铜的纯度。

d.m: 供给；提供；准备；规定；抚养

e.e: Sheep provide us with wool.
e.z: 羊供给我们羊毛。

e.e: The hotel provides a reservation of tickets for its residents.
e.z: 这家旅馆为旅客提供订票服务。

e.e: We have to provide for possible accidents.
e.z: 我们要为可能发生的意外作些准备。

e.e: Her book was published last year.
e.z: 她的书去年出版了。

e.e: He published this book with his pen-name .
e.z: 他以笔名出版了这本书。

e.e: Oxford University Press will publish a new magazine.
e.z: 牛津大学出版社将发行新杂志。

e.e: She purchased a number of shares in the company.
e.z: 她在公司里买了一些股票。

e.e: Tickets must be purchased two weeks in advance.
e.z: 票必须提前两周买。

e.e: The receipt is your proof of purchase.
e.z: 这张发票是你购物的凭据.

d.m: 追求；追捕；继续执行；从事

e.e: Everyone has the freedom to pursue their dreams.
e.z: 每个人都有追求各自梦想的自由。

e.e: The police are pursuing an escaped prisoner.
e.z: 警方正在追捕一名越狱的逃犯。

e.e: Let's not pursue this argument.
e.z: 让我们别再继续这个争论了。

d.m: 使具备资格；描述；[语]修饰

e.e: This test will qualify you to fly an aircraft.
e.z: 这次考试将使你取得驾驶飞机的资格。

e.e: His knowledge and skills qualify him for the job.
e.z: 他的知识和技能使他有资格担任这项工作。

e.e: Your passport qualifies you to receive free medical treatment.
e.z: 你所持的护照可使你享有免费医疗。

e.e: She asked the reporter not to quote her remarks.
e.z: 她要求记者不要引述她的话。

e.e: Please quote your price in terms of pound.
e.z: 请您报盘时用英镑报价。

e.e: Can you quote me a recent instance?
e.z: 你能给我举一个最近的例子吗？

d.m: 升起；举起；饲养；提出；引起；筹集，募集

e.e: The percentage of the pay raise equals the increase in prices.
e.z: 薪水的提高比率和物价的上升一致。

e.e: He got a raise in monthly wages.
e.z: 他的月薪增加了。

e.e: The first thing that we did when we conquered the town was to haul down the enemy's flag and raise our own.
e.z: 我们占领这座城市以后以后所做的第一件事就是降下城里敌人的旗帜，升起我们自己的旗帜。

e.e: Iron reacts with water and air to produce rust.
e.z: 铁与水和空气起化学反应而生锈。

e.e: She reacted to the insult by turning her back on him.
e.z: 她受辱之后就不再理睬他了。

e.e: How did they react to your suggestion?
e.z: 他们对你的建议有什么反应？

e.e: Neither John nor I am to receive the award.
e.z: 约翰和我谁都不会接到奖赏。

e.e: I was on vacation last week and didn't receive your fax.
e.z: 上星期我正在度假，没收到你们的传真。

e.e: He was received as an honoured visitor.
e.z: 他以贵宾的身分受到款待。

d.m: 承认；认出；意识到；表示感激；识别

e.e: His thorough knowledge and competence were recognized.
e.z: 他的渊博的学识和工作能力得到了承认。

e.e: I recognize your right to ask that question.
e.z: 我承认你有权提出这个问题。

e.e: Can you recognize her from this picture?
e.z: 你能从这张照片中认出她吗？

d.m: 推荐；建议；劝告；使受欢迎；使可取

e.e: Can you recommend me some new books on this subject?
e.z: 你能推荐一些有关这个学科的新书给我吗?

e.e: I should recommend it as a useful reference book.
e.z: 我愿意推荐它作为一本有用的参考书。

e.e: I recommend you to buy this dictionary and that tape.
e.z: 我建议你买这本字典和那盒磁带。

e.e: He's now fully recovered from his stroke.
e.z: 他现已从中风病完全康复了。

e.e: He is very ill and unlikely to recover.
e.z: 他病得非常厉害，不大可能恢复健康了。

e.e: I nearly fell but managed to recover myself.
e.z: 我差一点倒下,但最后还是站稳了脚根。

d.m: 减少；缩小；使落魄；简化；还原

e.e: The new government's prime task is to reduce the level of inflation.
e.z: 新政府的主要任务是减低通货膨胀的水平。

e.e: We need to reduce our dependence on oil as a source of energy.
e.z: 在能源方面,我们需减少对石油的依赖。

e.e: We must gradually reduce the wage gap.
e.z: 我们要逐步缩小工资差距。

d.m: 把 ... 提交；把 ... 归因；归类

e.e: We referred the proposal to the board of directors.
e.z: 我们把这一建议提交董事会处理。

e.e: You should refer this matter to the head office for a decision.
e.z: 你应当把这事提交总部去决定。

e.e: He referred all his troubles to bad luck.
e.z: 他将他的一切麻烦都归因于运气不好。

d.m: 反映；反射；反省；归咎；显示

e.e: Her sad looks reflected the thought passing through her mind.
e.z: 她忧戚的面容反映出她内心的思想。

e.e: The results reflect the greatest credit upon all concerned.
e.z: 这些成绩带给所有有关人员最大的荣誉。

e.e: The sunlight was reflected in the water.
e.z: 日光由水面反射出来。

e.e: Our reform made an inexorable march of progress.
e.z: 我们的改革取得了势不可挡的进展。

e.e: Many reforms must be made to the education system.
e.z: 教育体制要作许多改革。

e.e: The reform and open policy has Brought us Chinese people a rich and colourful life.

d.m: 免职；解雇；摒弃；不予理会

e.z: 对他的免职他们又补加了一页。

e.z: 他必须意识到失败了就要被免职。

e.z: 这五次试验所获得的结果迥然不同。

e.z: 粉笔和乳酪是完全不同的东西。

e.z: 有着这么多根本不相同的政治集团，这个国家是真正陷入了困境。

e.z: 这种玩具机关枪很容易拆卸。

d.m: 使 ... 失去方向感； 使 ... 迷惑

e.z: 这些方法都会使头脑失去方向感，诱使潜意识调谐至星体层的另一部分。

e.z: 除了这个技能，侦查还有烟雾弹技能，这将减缓并迷惑怪物，并造成攻击丢失。

e.e: It is the task of a fighter to dispel darkness.
e.z: 驱散黑暗，这是战士的任务。

e.z: 任何东西都无法驱散那些冷漠观众的困倦。

e.e: I thought,if I had caused the cloud,it was my duty to make an effort to dispel it.
e.z: 我想，如果是我引起了这块乌云，那我就该负责努力驱散它。

d.m: 派遣；发送；迅速完成；处死
急件；派遣；发送；新闻报道

e.e: A messenger was dispatched to take the news to the soldiers at the front.
e.z: 一名通讯员被派去给前线士兵送消息。

e.z: 我们得要求你立即发送该批货物。

e.z: 我们很快就吃完了那个巧克力蛋糕。

d.m: 冷静的；不带感情的；平心静气的

e.e: First offers, no matter how lucrative, must be met with a dispassionate eye.
e.z: 第一轮出价,不论多么有利可图,一定要冷静面对。

e.e: You should be dispassionate even if you get some success in the negotiation.
e.z: 假使在谈判中取得一些成功，你还是保持冷静为好。

e.z: 拿这个处方到药房，他们就会给你配药了。

e.z: 他从学校的医务室买了一些药片。

d.m: 不是必要的；可有可无的

e.z: 汽车房虽然有用

e.z: 他后悔因害怕处罚而补偿了不必要的养老金。

e.z: 他们认为音乐课和美术课是可有可无的。

e.z: 阴沉的天气让我们都感到压抑。

e.z: 他翻来复去，等到伦敦那阴沉的白天开始上曙光，便一骨碌爬了起来，前往柏利街他叔父的寓所。

e.e: The police dispersed the crowd.
e.z: 警方驱散群众。

e.z: 风吹散了天上的云。

e.e: The enemy had to disperse and hide in caves.
e.z: 敌人不得不分散藏身于洞穴之中。

e.z: 她对他的行为充满了厌恶。

e.z: 她丈夫没注意到她的新发型，这使她大为不快。

d.m: 可任意处理的；一次性的

e.z: 会议结束后,可以任意处理这本小册子。

e.z: 这个广告的对象是那些二十多岁且可支配收入高的人士。

e.z: 这些医用棉球仅限于一次性使用。

e.z: 垃圾的处理总是个难题。

d.m: 清除；处理掉；解决；杀死；打败

d.m: 性情；倾向；安排；处置；控制；[计算机] 配置情况

e.z: 她性格文静内向。

e.z: 根据解剖结果，此人死于心脏病发作。

e.z: 她进行了首次解剖后就改变了要当医生的想法。

e.z: 两队实力悬殊，所以比赛并不精彩。

e.z: 这也许是我们在组织领域中所获得最富有成效的新见识。

d.m: 产量多地；肥沃地；富有成果地

e.e: They stocked the freezer with frozen foods.
e.z: 他们把冰箱里装满了冰冻食品。

e.z: 母亲在冰箱里存放了蔬菜。

e.z: 我们应该把这个防在冷藏室还是冷冻室?

e.e: But a diet loaded with fat and fructose hampers the regulation of these hormones.
e.z: 不过含有过量脂肪和果糖的食物影响了这些荷尔蒙的调节功能。

e.z: 果糖是大多数的人体必需的基本高级碳水化合物之一。

e.z: 树枝上果实累累。

e.z: 花崇拜时便成了果实。

e.z: 他们的研究课题还未取得成果。

d.m: 取得成果；成就；实现；完成

e.e: Our efforts have come to fruition.
e.z: 我们的努力有了成果。

e.z: 他不切实际的想法永远没有实现。

e.z: 我们把皱眉当作不赞成的表示。

e.z: 我们努力说服她，但毫无成效。

e.z: 他试图说服她站到自己一边的努力徒劳无功。

e.z: 到目前为止，还没有找到那失踪的男孩。

d.m: 挫折；失败；令人沮丧的东西

e.z: 受挫折后发泄一通比强忍着对身体有益。

e.e: The cat sat in front of the bird cage in an agony of frustration at being so near and yet so far.
e.z: 猫无可奈何地坐在鸟笼前，眼看着鸟儿近在咫尺，可怎么也够不着。

e.z: 他因失败而把牙咬得咯咯响。

d.m: 耗油低的；燃料消耗低的
（杠杆的）支点；支柱；最重要的部分

e.z: 给我一个支承的支点，我就会转动地球。

e.z: 许多人视婚姻为生命最重要的部分。

e.z: 对于广播经营来说，品牌就是它的一个支点。

e.e: Coal is used as fuel.
e.z: 煤用作燃料。

e.z: 他无动于衷使她心中的怨恨火上加油。

e.e: I'm feeling rather frustrated in my present job; I need a change.
e.z: 我感到现在干得很不顺心，需要换一换工作。

e.z: 他们在学校同样经常感到失意。

e.z: 玛丽因工作得不到赏识而灰心丧气。

d.m: 逃亡的；易逝的；难以捉摸的

e.e: The fugitive took refuge in a deserted house.
e.z: 那个逃亡者躲在一所废弃的旧房子里。

e.z: 据信，逃亡者正向加拿大边界方向逃窜。

e.z: 幸运的是，逃亡的李磊已经于上周六在三亚落网。

e.e: Whatever happens I'm determined to fulfill it.
e.z: 不管发生什么,我都决心完成它。

e.e: How they laid about them to fulfill the task!
e.z: 他们是何等竭尽全力来完成这一任务啊！

e.e: You must fulfill your promise.
e.z: 你必须履行诺言。

e.e: The eggs are frying in the pan.
e.z: 鸡蛋正在平底锅里煎着。

e.e: We cut it into thin slices and fry it.
e.z: 我们把它切成薄片并用油煎。

e.e: Shall I fry the fish for dinner?
e.z: 晚饭要不要我炸鱼？

d.m: 挫败；击败；使沮丧；使灰心

e.e: This is the place that we frustrate enemy.
e.z: 这是我们挫败敌人的地方。

e.e: They made their preparations to frustrate the conspiracy.
e.z: 他们作好准备挫败以这个阴谋。

e.e: The terrible weather frustrated our hopes of going out.
e.z: 恶劣的天气使我们外出的愿望无法实现。

e.z: 人们在为一个共同目标而努力的过程中得到满足。

e.z: 我不禁自问，工作真的能给一个人带来那么大的满足感和成就感吗？

e.e: In task one, task fulfillment is important.
e.z: 在任务一中，完成任务是很重要的。

e.e: Witnessing a child's development into a young reader is one of the most fulfilling experiences I could imagine.
e.z: 亲眼看到孩子成为一个年轻的读者，是我所想象出的最令人满意的经历。

d.m: 十分地；完全地；全部；足足

e.z: 我们十分清楚形势的严峻性。

e.e: He is fully satisfied with his income.
e.z: 他对他的收入十分满意。

e.e: I don't fully understand his reasons for leaving.
e.z: 我不完全理解他离开的理由。

e.e: The fireman was suffocated by the fumes.
e.z: 那个消防队员让浓烟憋死了。

e.e: The fume caused by coalburning is one of the main air pollutants in China.
e.z: 燃煤烟尘是我国最主要的大气污染物之一。

e.e: The ground was hidden by a white fume.
e.z: 地面上笼罩着一层白色的水汽。

e.e: Hotels are often full in season
e.z: 在度假旺季,旅馆经常客满。

e.e: He gave a boring speech full of stale jokes.
e.z: 他的发言很乏味,满是陈腐的笑话。

e.e: The bottle is full of water.

d.m: 职务；功能；函数；重大聚会；应变量，有相关关系者；取决于

e.e: What is his function on the committee?
e.z: 他在委员会里担任什么职务?

e.z: 老师没有解释它的文法功能。

e.e: The function of the ear is to listen.
e.z: 耳的功能是听。

e.e: She felt sick from breathing in paint fumes.
e.z: 她因吸入油漆气味而感到恶心。

e.e: The air was thick with tobacco fumes.
e.z: 空气中有浓厚的菸草气味。

e.e: They are not affected by poisonous fumes or gases.
e.z: 他们不受有毒烟雾或气体影响。

d.m: (形) 全職的；全時間的　(副) 全職地；全時間地

e.e: If Maria worked full-time at the bookstore, she would earn enough money for university tuition.
e.z: 如果瑪麗亞在書店全職工作，她就能賺到足夠的大學學費。

d.m: 功能的；实用的；起作用的

e.e: What are the functional benefits of the brand?
e.z: 你的品牌的功能方面的益处是什么?

e.e: This is a fully functional automaton.
e.z: 这是一个有全自动功能的机器人。

e.e: The computer looks compact and functional.
e.z: 这个计算机看起来小巧而实用.

e.e: Our company is in want of fund.
e.z: 我们的公司需要资金。

e.z: 该养老基金在几家主要出售股份给公众的公司中均有股份。

e.e: That's your problem.

e.z: 我们没有时间仔细思考这个问题.

d.m: 用探针测；探测；详细调查

e.z: 她是一个极漂亮的姑娘，我无法把目光从她身上移开。

d.m: 惊人地；令人目瞪口呆地

e.e: The three rapid-fire shots that rang out at Dodger Stadium came so stunningly out-of-nowhere that it seemed fitting for one collective oddity to deserve another.
e.z: 在道奇球场突然响起的快炮三连轰让人目瞪口呆，但这看起来却与怪事接二连三发上的今晚相互呼应。

e.e: The sturdy young man removed the rock without effort.
e.z: 那个壮实的小伙子没费多大劲便把石块搬开了。

e.e: His son has grown up into a sturdy hardworking young man.
e.z: 他的儿子已成长为一个健壮勤劳的小伙子。

e.e: That chair doesn't look very sturdy.
e.z: 椅子看上其不坚固。

e.e: I'd like something for a stye, too.
e.z: 我还想要治麦粒肿的药。

e.e: Those who stutter often receive speech therapy.
e.z: 那些口吃者经常接受语言治疗。

e.e: I always stutter on my words when I get nervous.
e.z: 当我感到紧张时，我说话总是结巴。

e.e: He speaks with a slight stutter.
e.z: 他说话有点口吃。

e.e: The noise of someone banging at the door roused her from her stupor.
e.z: 梆梆的敲门声把她从昏迷中唤醒了。

e.z: 昆塔麻木地躺在那里，陷于一种痴呆的状态。

e.e: He lay on the bed in a drunken stupor.
e.z: 他躺在床上醉的不省人事.

e.e: I love to dress my dog in stylish clothes.
e.z: 我喜欢给我的狗穿上时髦的衣服.

e.e: She's expert at making cheap, but stylish clothes.
e.z: 她做便宜而时髦的衣服很在行。

e.e: With excellent reputation, our company intends to bring the best of china from China and creates innovative ideas of stylish tableware.
e.z: 基于良好的信誉，我们旨在为流行的器型赋予新品位，为客户带来最卓越的瓷器。

e.e: Much of this work seeks to comprehend, in stylized theoretical settings, the unfolding of economic events over time.
e.z: 这其中，大量的工作尝试着在一种程式化的理论背景下，去了解经济事态随着时间变化的演变。

e.e: For the interior Volvo has continued the sporty theme by adding aluminum inserts in the steering wheel, door mouldings and the stylized center stack.
e.z: 为室内沃尔沃继续运动主题加上铝插入方向盘，门装饰和程式化的中控台。

e.e: The showdown with Mr.Fu is a stylized slow-mo sequence with men on both sides holding umbrellas with the surreal air of a Magritte painting.
e.z: 付先生的摊牌是一个风格化的慢动作，两个人拿着伞彼此张望着，就像充满了超现实主义的氛围的玛格丽特油画。

d.m: 使 ... 处于困难境地； 妨碍

e.e: Social stigmas attached to homosexuality and bisexuality stymie public health efforts and allow the virus to spread rapidly in many parts of the region.
e.z: 社会不齿同性恋与双性恋也妨碍公共卫生行动，让病毒得以在该区域的许多地方快速散播。

d.m: 风格上的；文体上；格式上的；体裁上的

e.e: All their works have stylistic similarities.
e.z: 他们的作品风格相近。

e.e: The city architecture shows stylistic variation.
e.z: 城市建筑学展现出格调上的多样性。

e.e: At present they are studying the stylistic device.
e.z: 现在他们正在研究文体表现手法。

e.e: These may be conscious or subconscious, emotional or experiential.
e.z: 这些可能是意识或是潜意识，情感或是经历。

e.e: One's conscious motives are often different from one's subconscious ones.
e.z: 一个人有明显动机的举动跟下意识的举动往往截然不同。

e.e: My answer seemed to come from the subconscious.
e.z: 我的回答似乎出自下意识。

e.z: 当地广播报导，这艘潜艇内配备氧气桶。

e.z: 核动力潜艇能比其他任何潜艇驶得快。

e.z: 裁判病了，我得代为裁判。

d.m: 文体；风格；式样；时尚；类型

e.e: The letter is written in formal style.
e.z: 这封信是用正式文体写的。

e.e: I wouldn't tell lies to you; that's not my style.
e.z: 我不会跟你撒谎，那不是我的风格。

e.e: The style of this skirt is just in season.
e.z: 这条裙子的款式正当时令。

d.m: 屈服的；柔和的；减弱的；被抑制的

e.e: The subdued moonlit glare helps to bring out more of the lunar landscape.
e.z: 柔和的月光会帮助我们更多更好的勾勒出月球的景象。

e.e: calm drivers get wound up by subdued, low-key voices that don't vary in pitch.
e.z: 熟练的驾驶者对那种柔和的毫无变化的语调感到厌烦.

e.e: There is a subdued atmosphere in the school at exam time.
e.z: 在考试期间，学校里有一种压抑的氛围。

d.m: 使震惊；使目瞪口呆；使昏迷

e.e: This speech seemed to stun the king.
e.z: 这话似乎使国王大吃一惊。

e.e: He was stunned by the sudden news.
e.z: 他因听到这突然的消息而目瞪口呆。

d.m: 高尚的；壮观的；非凡的；极其的

e.e: You may also imbibe it slowly in small sips to appreciate the subtle allure of tea-drinking, until your spirits soar up and up into a sublime aesthetic realm.
e.z: 在百忙之中泡上一壶浓茶，择雅静之处，自斟自饮，可以消除疲劳、涤烦益思、振奋精神，也可以细啜慢饮，达到美的享受，使精神世界升华到高尚的艺术境界。

e.e: I like sublime mountain scenery.
e.z: 我喜爱壮丽的山景。

e.e: In the matter of profanity he was sublime.
e.z: 他破口乱骂的本领，也是卓越非凡的。

e.e: No one has been able to subdue these areas.
e.z: 从没有人能够压制这一地区。

e.z: 索米斯在屋内兜了一圈，压制一下心头升起的怒火。

e.e: Subconsciously, she was looking for the father she had never known.
e.z: 她在下意识地寻找自己从未见过的父亲。

e.e: Subconsciously I felt something untoward was going to happen.
e.z: 我下意识地感到要出事。

e.e: What ever was done in the past becomes part of you for the rest of your life consciously or subconsciously.
e.z: 过去你不管做了什么，有意识或潜意识地它都会成为你下半生的一部分。

e.e: The frigate rammed the submarine.
e.z: 护卫舰撞击了潜艇。

e.e: The ship was sunk by an atomic submarine.
e.z: 这艘船是被一艘核潜艇击沉的。

e.e: A submarine glided silently through the water.
e.z: 一艘潜水艇无声地在水中滑行。

e.e: I watched the submarine submerge.
e.z: 我望着潜艇潜入水中。

d.m: 话题；科目；主题；题材；主观；[语]主语

e.e: She dare not mention the subject again.
e.z: 她不敢重提那个话题。

e.e: Mathematics is her favorite subject.
e.z: 数学是她喜欢的科目。

e.e: He is said to be writing a paper on this subject.
e.z: 据说他正在写一篇关于这个主题的论文。

d.m: 愚蠢的；笨拙的；无聊的；乏味的

e.z: 真是个愚蠢的白痴！

e.z: 我认为他生来就愚笨。

d.m: 订阅；签署；同意；捐款；会费

e.z: 你交订阅费了吗？

e.z: 我的订阅期到上个月为止。

syn.m: 表示状态的关闭或离开...

e.z: 他主要靠蔬菜和水果维持生命。

e.z: 别担心你的孩子们，我可以供养他们。

e.z: 中日"东海问题"的实质及展望

e.z: 金刚砂是非常坚硬的金属物质。

e.z: 他的批评大体上是正确的。

e.e: His opinion accords substantially with mine.
e.z: 他的意见和我的意见实质上是一致的。

e.e: Two from five is a simple subtraction.

e.e: If you work hard you will succeed.

e.e: We succeeded in repairing the engine.
e.z: 我们成功地修好了发动机。

e.z: 公爵去世之后，他的长子将继承他的爵位。

e.z: 新的经济发展政策带来了快速和大量的增长。

e.z: 近几年那些工人建造了许多坚固的建筑。

e.z: 改革取得了实质的进展。

e.z: 请扣除四分之一的钱由你自己支配使用。

e.z: 这小女孩已在学做加减法了。

e.z: 他的目标是成为一个成功的作家。

e.z: 他们经商非常成功。
